verdict.rationale: Docs describe update mechanisms (customId lets Supermemory 'intelligently process only what's new' on repeat ingestion, user profiles 'update as users interact', and a living knowledge graph builds facts on facts) that imply merging/updating over time, but there is no explicit documentation of contradiction detection or supersession logic, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this behavior works as claimed. missing for 10: explicit contradiction-detection/conflict-resolution documentation, hands-on or third-party verification that old contradicted facts are actually superseded rather than duplicated.
